items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: when I went by Martin's Ghost on Arlene and Robson

ctx.x: I said, oh, where do you want, brother?

I said, give me A. I told you, I think about that piece of paper in my pocket. Give me A. Boom, boom, boom, boom, quang, quang, that whole string kept on going. The key, you know. I got that tune up, that tune up, my D and my G. I said, I play some more, right? My air is all playing, turn around there. But really, while I was first, then I knew the key. And the old key for me, they make on that bass was B flat. And the same thing you make F or C. When I come to me, I says, then they was playing a piece in 4G.…
